budget.form: BUDGET := 0.5 x ||fact - base|| (the write's own norm, fp64 from the loaded fact); S_total = S_corpus + S_maint BOTH counted (the dispatch: the maintenance steps' displacement counts against it)
budget.reservation: EQUAL-SHARE over ALL remaining optimizer events: cap_t = ((BUDGET - S_total)/(rem_corpus + rem_maint)) / ||b_t||; lr_t = min(LR_STABLE x cosine, cap_t); the corpus side alone is triangle-bounded; the maintenance lr is FROZEN (uncapped) — its displacement enters S_total; G_BUDGET checks the TOTAL (non-halting: a failure routes to MAINTENANCE-FAILS)

RE-ANCHORED.desc: (a) RE-ANCHORED (the build): the e285 sanctuary form VERBATIM (separate buffers + orthogonal projection + the 0.5x budget) PLUS a periodic maintenance step: every M=25 corpus steps, take ONE install-stream gradient step at a small maintenance lr (start at 1/100 of the install's formation lr; the fact's own gradient — the anchor's weight, not a fixed direction), applied through the FACT-side buffer (keeping the separation). The maintenance steps re-center the read's operative context. 400 corpus steps total, 16 maintenance steps.

SANCTUARY-TWIN.desc: (b) SANCTUARY-TWIN (the control): e285's arm verbatim this session (the passive stack without maintenance — the same-session pair).

bars_verbatim.RE-ANCHORED-HOLDS: >= 0.5x at t400 with the stream live (the corpus CE improving) and the budget held — THE FIRST ACTIVE SURVIVAL: memory maintained by the organism's own dynamics under traffic; the build lane's founding success.
bars_verbatim.MAINTENANCE-PARTIAL: 0.05x-0.5x — the sawtooth visible (maintenance lifts the read between steps) but insufficient at this cadence/lr; the mechanism works, the tuning doesn't; report the trajectory shape + the maintenance-lr sensitivity honestly.
bars_verbatim.MAINTENANCE-FAILS: < 0.05x or the maintenance steps break the budget/orthogonality gates — the active design's first form fails; the trajectories verbatim.

adjudication.composite_order: TEXTURE (any bind/isolation hard-gate failure — HALT) -> MAINTENANCE-FAILS-by-gates (G_BUDGET blown OR G_ORTH failed, any ratio — the dispatch's gates clause) -> RE-ANCHORED-HOLDS (ratio_400 >= 0.5 AND corpus-CE improving AND gates pass) -> MAINTENANCE-PARTIAL (0.05 <= ratio_400 < 0.5 AND gates pass) -> MAINTENANCE-FAILS-by-ratio (ratio_400 < 0.05 AND gates pass) -> MIXED (everything else) — frozen at birth

honesty.intervention_not_logits: the two arms share ONE loaded artifact (the committed quiet-formed 10k write, md5/flat-md5/behavior-gated), the same milestone cadence, the same reads, and BIT-IDENTICAL corpus draws (one generator, seed 28601, one draw order) — the ONLY delta is the maintenance mechanism (16 install-gradient steps through the fact-side SGD-M at MAINT_LR). The rooms are identical across arms BY CONSTRUCTION (one bit-gated room).
honesty.the_maintenance_disclosure: the maintenance step is the fact's OWN stream verbatim (the Dmix batch that formed it), unprojected, at 1/100 of the install's SGD-denominated formation lr; its token mass is ~99% corpus-direction (112 name tokens vs 12240 corpus tokens) — the re-anchoring signal rides the name positions; the maint ledger's per-step in-room fraction + the window shape are the mechanism's own direction read, measured never assumed
honesty.the_budget_disclosure: the maintenance displacement counts against the same 0.5x budget (the dispatch); the corpus cap reserves across ALL remaining optimizer events, so the corpus stream pays the maintenance's transport bill in lr — the split ledger discloses who consumed what; a blown budget adjudicates MAINTENANCE-FAILS, never a HALT
honesty.the_separation_disclosure: the fact side's buffer is the maintenance instrument (its own momentum, persistent across maintenance steps); the isolation is BIDIRECTIONAL and machine-checked bitwise around EVERY optimizer event; buf_F's composition is disclosed per milestone (never a bar) — the corpus buffer stays at the fp floor (< 1e-4)
honesty.n_and_scope: n=1 per arm, one lineage, one session (the g-series standing lottery caveat carried verbatim); the arms' DIFFERENCE is the registered object; nothing guaranteed
honesty.loads_measured_not_nominal: every read is measured: the per-event realized displacement (corpus and maintenance separately), the S split, the per-milestone interval + cumulative projections (fp64), the buffer-composition ledgers, the orthogonality ledger (every step), the maintenance ledger (every step), the corpus CE + clipped-grad ledgers, the between-steps window reads — never nominal
honesty.nothing_guaranteed: the dispatch's own caveat carried: no outcome was promised; the bars cover all branches and the trajectories are reported verbatim regardless
